recent_changes.description: Built assembleDebug APK and deployed to OnePlus SM8650 device via MCP ADB tool. Live log verified: 1 network call for story detail (instead of 5), seamless playback, 0 buffer underruns
Implemented Phase 03: StoryDetailActivity content cache guard (loadedStoryId) & in-flight network request deduplication guard (isLoadingContent), plus StoryDetailContentCacheGuardTest
Implemented Phase 02: ReadingService prepareStory idempotency guard (preparedStoryId, preparedVoice, isPreparingStory) with fast-exit and state synchronization, plus ReadingServicePrepareGuardTest
Implemented Phase 01: AndroidManifest.xml singleTop launchMode for StoryDetailActivity and onNewIntent handler for intent updating & dynamic story reload, plus StoryDetailSingleTopTest

decisions_made.reason: Eliminates duplicate activity instances when tapping stories multiple times or returning from notifications.

decisions_made.decision: Tri-Layer Defense for Story Preparation & Content Fetching
decisions_made.reason: Prevents redundant network calls (Layer 3), avoids duplicate ONNX background preparation jobs (Layer 2), and stops activity stacking (Layer 1).
